cats.name: 语法
cats.desc: 动词不定式、should / could、反身代词、although / until / so that、比较级与最高级、大数字、过去进行时、so … that / unless / as soon as、现在完成时……

cats.name: 句型与交际
cats.desc: 谈爱好、看病、谈烦恼、介绍自然奇观、谈灾害经历、谈习俗、谈读书、谈志愿服务等课本重点句型

points.title: 动词不定式作目的状语和宾语补足语
points.explain:
① 作目的状语，说明「为了做某事」：I started swimming to get over my fear.
② 作宾语补足语：ask / tell / want / encourage / allow sb to do sth
My parents told me not to push myself too hard.（否定在 to 前加 not）
③ 注意：make / let / help 后面常跟不带 to 的不定式：Painting helps me (to) express how I feel. / My mum lets me play games on Saturdays.

examples.en: I started swimming to get over my fear.
examples.zh: 我开始游泳是为了克服我的恐惧。

examples.en: She told me not to give up so easily.
examples.zh: 她告诉我不要这么轻易放弃。

questions.q: I got up early ______ the first bus.
questions.e: 表示目的「为了赶第一班车」，用不定式 to catch。
questions.s: I got up early to catch the first bus.

questions.q: My coach encourages me ______ hard every day.
questions.e: encourage sb to do sth。
questions.s: My coach encourages me to practise hard every day.

questions.q: The doctor told him ______ too many sweets.
questions.e: tell sb not to do sth，not 放在 to 前。
questions.s: The doctor told him not to eat too many sweets.

questions.q: My parents let me ______ out with friends on Saturdays.
questions.e: let sb do sth，不带 to。
questions.s: My parents let me hang out with friends on Saturdays.

questions.q: I go to the park every morning ______ yoga.
questions.e: 表示目的，用 to do。
questions.s: I go to the park every morning to do yoga.

questions.q: My teacher asked us ______ (write) about our hobbies.
questions.e: ask sb to do sth。
questions.s: My teacher asked us to write about our hobbies.

questions.a: I listen to music to relax.
questions.e: listen to music 后面加 to relax 表示目的。
questions.s: I listen to music to relax.

points.title: 谈爱好及其好处
points.explain:
问爱好：What do you do in your free time? / How did you get into it?
说开始：I took up … last year. / I decided to give it a go.
说好处：It helps me relax / reduce stress / make friends. / It gives me a sense of achievement.

examples.en: How did you get into painting?
examples.zh: 你是怎么开始画画的？

examples.en: I decided to give it a go too!
examples.zh: 我决定也试一试！

questions.q:
— What do you usually do in your ______ time?
— I play the guitar.
questions.e: free time 空闲时间。
questions.s:
— What do you usually do in your free time?
— I play the guitar.

questions.q: Hanging out with friends can ______ stress.
questions.e: reduce stress 减轻压力。
questions.s: Hanging out with friends can reduce stress.

questions.q:
— Have you tried kung fu?
— Not yet, but I'd like to give it a ______.
questions.e: give it a go 试一试。
questions.s:
— Have you tried kung fu?
— Not yet, but I'd like to give it a go.

questions.q: Painting helps me ______ (表达) how I feel.
questions.e: help sb (to) do sth，express 表达。
questions.s: Painting helps me express how I feel.

questions.a: How did you get into it?
questions.e: get into 开始做（某事）。
questions.s: How did you get into it?

points.kp: 情态动词后接动词原形
points.title: should / could 给建议
points.explain:
should 应该（建议性强）：You should see a dentist. / You shouldn't eat too much.
could 可以（语气委婉，提供可能的办法）：You could take some medicine.
问建议：What should I do? / What's the matter? — I have a headache.
情态动词后接动词原形。

examples.en: You should see a dentist.
examples.zh: 你应该去看牙医。

examples.en: You should take some medicine and drink enough water.
examples.zh: 你应该吃点药，多喝水。

questions.q:
— I have a sore throat.
— You ______ drink some warm water with honey.
questions.e: 给建议「应该喝温蜂蜜水」，用 should。
questions.s:
— I have a sore throat.
— You should drink some warm water with honey.

questions.q: You ______ play computer games for so long. It's bad for your eyes.
questions.e: 对眼睛不好，所以不应该：shouldn't。
questions.s: You shouldn't play computer games for so long. It's bad for your eyes.

questions.q:
— What's the ______ with you?
— I have a fever.
questions.e: What's the matter with you? 你怎么了？
questions.s:
— What's the matter with you?
— I have a fever.

questions.q: You could ______ a rest at home.
questions.e: could 后接动词原形。
questions.s: You could take a rest at home.

questions.q: You ______ (应该) go to bed early.
questions.e: 表示建议用 should。
questions.s: You should go to bed early.

questions.e: should + 动词原形。
questions.s: You should see a dentist.

points.title: 反身代词
points.explain:
myself, yourself, himself, herself, itself, ourselves, yourselves, themselves
① 动作作用于自己：He hurt himself. / Take care of yourself.
② 固定搭配：enjoy oneself 玩得开心，teach oneself 自学，help yourself to … 随便吃，by oneself 独自

examples.en: If we are not careful, we can easily hurt ourselves.
examples.zh: 如果我们不小心，很容易伤到自己。

examples.en: Lastly, remember to take care of yourself.
examples.zh: 最后，记得照顾好自己。

questions.q: Be careful with the knife, Tom. Don't cut ______.
questions.e: 对 Tom 一个人说，用 yourself。
questions.s: Be careful with the knife, Tom. Don't cut yourself.

questions.q: The children enjoyed ______ at the party.
questions.e: enjoy oneself 玩得开心，主语复数用 themselves。
questions.s: The children enjoyed themselves at the party.

questions.q: She taught ______ to play the guitar.
questions.e: teach oneself 自学。
questions.s: She taught herself to play the guitar.

questions.q:
— Help ______ to some fish, boys and girls.
— Thank you.
questions.e: 对多人说「随便吃」，用 yourselves。
questions.s:
— Help yourselves to some fish, boys and girls.
— Thank you.

questions.q: I fell off my bike and hurt ______ (我自己).
questions.e: hurt oneself 伤到自己。
questions.s: I fell off my bike and hurt myself.

questions.q: We should look after ______ (我们自己).
questions.e: 主语 We，用 ourselves。
questions.s: We should look after ourselves.

points.title: 看病用语
points.explain:
医生：What's the matter? / How long have you been like this? / Let me take your temperature.
病人：I have a cold / fever / headache / stomachache / toothache. / I hurt my arm.
建议：Take some medicine. / Drink more water. / Have a good rest.

examples.en: I have a runny nose and a fever.
examples.zh: 我流鼻涕，还发烧。

examples.en: Let me take your temperature.
examples.zh: 我来给你量一下体温。

questions.q:
— What's the matter?
— I ______ a stomachache.
questions.e: have a stomachache 胃痛。
questions.s:
— What's the matter?
— I have a stomachache.

questions.q: I ate too much last night, so I have a ______ now.
questions.e: 吃太多会胃痛。
questions.s: I ate too much last night, so I have a stomachache now.

questions.q: The nurse took my ______ and said I had a fever.
questions.e: take one's temperature 量体温。
questions.s: The nurse took my temperature and said I had a fever.

questions.q: You'd better lie down and have a ______ (休息).
questions.e: have a rest 休息一下。
questions.s: You'd better lie down and have a rest.

questions.e: 询问病情：What's the matter with you?
questions.s: What's the matter with you?

points.title: 连词 although / until / so that
points.explain:
although 虽然（不能和 but 连用）：Although he was tired, he kept working.
until 直到：I waited until he came. / not … until 直到……才：I didn't go to bed until 11.
so that 以便、为了：We should talk so that we can clear the air.

examples.en: We should talk so that we can clear the air.
examples.zh: 我们应该谈一谈，以便消除误会。

examples.en: I couldn't talk about my feelings to anybody until you sat with me during lunch that day.
examples.zh: 直到那天午饭时你坐到我身边，我才能跟别人说出自己的感受。

questions.q: ______ it was raining, they still played football.
questions.e: 前后是让步关系「虽然下雨，仍然踢球」。
questions.s: Although it was raining, they still played football.

questions.q: Although he is young, ______ he knows a lot.
questions.e: although 和 but 不能同时使用。
questions.s: Although he is young, he knows a lot.

questions.q: I didn't go to sleep ______ my mum came home.
questions.e: not … until 直到……才。
questions.s: I didn't go to sleep until my mum came home.

questions.q: Speak louder ______ everyone can hear you.
questions.e: so that 以便，表示目的。
questions.s: Speak louder so that everyone can hear you.

questions.q: Wait here ______ I come back.
questions.e: until 直到……为止。
questions.s: Wait here until I come back.

questions.q: She got up early so ______ she could catch the first bus.
questions.e: so that 以便，引导目的状语从句。
questions.s: She got up early so that she could catch the first bus.

questions.a: She kept working although she was tired.
questions.e: although 引导让步状语从句，主句不用 but。
questions.s: She kept working although she was tired.

points.title: 谈烦恼与给建议
points.explain:
说烦恼：I'm upset / angry / stressed because … / I feel blue.
给建议：Why don't you …? / You could … / How about …? / Try to look on the bright side.
安慰：Don't be too hard on yourself. / Everyone makes mistakes.

examples.en: Don't be too hard on yourself!
examples.zh: 别对自己太苛刻了！

examples.en: But look on the bright side.
examples.zh: 但要往好的方面想。

questions.q:
— I failed the test.
— Don't be too hard ______ yourself.
questions.e: be hard on sb 对某人苛刻。
questions.s:
— I failed the test.
— Don't be too hard on yourself.

questions.q:
— I had a fight with my best friend.
— ______ write him a letter?
questions.e: Why don't you + 动词原形？给建议。
questions.s:
— I had a fight with my best friend.
— Why don't you write him a letter?

questions.q: Peter couldn't control his ______ and shouted at Harry.
questions.e: control one's anger 控制怒火，需要名词。
questions.s: Peter couldn't control his anger and shouted at Harry.

questions.q: How about ______ (talk) to your parents?
questions.e: How about + doing？
questions.s: How about talking to your parents?

questions.e: look on the bright side 往好的方面想。
questions.s: Look on the bright side.

points.title: 比较级和最高级（复习）
points.explain:
两者比较用比较级 + than：The Yangtze River is longer than the Yellow River.
三者及以上用 the + 最高级 + in / of：Mount Qomolangma is the highest mountain in the world.
副词也有比较级、最高级：He runs faster than me.
不规则：good / well → better → best，bad → worse → worst，many / much → more → most
Which is … , A or B? / one of the + 最高级 + 名词复数

examples.en: No, the Yangtze River is the longest river in China.
examples.zh: 不，长江是中国最长的河。

examples.en: It is the biggest coral reef in the world.
examples.zh: 它是世界上最大的珊瑚礁。

questions.q: The Nile is ______ river in the world.
questions.e: 「世界上最长的」，用 the + 最高级。
questions.s: The Nile is the longest river in the world.

questions.q: Lake Baikal is ______ than any other lake in the world.
questions.e: than any other + 单数名词，用比较级。
questions.s: Lake Baikal is deeper than any other lake in the world.

questions.q: The Great Wall is one of the ______ wonders in the world.
questions.e: one of the + 最高级 + 复数名词。
questions.s: The Great Wall is one of the greatest wonders in the world.

questions.q: Tom runs ______ than his brother.
questions.e: 两者比较，副词用比较级 faster。
questions.s: Tom runs faster than his brother.

questions.q: This is the ______ (bad) weather I have ever seen.
questions.e: bad 的最高级是 worst。
questions.s: This is the worst weather I have ever seen.

questions.q: The Sahara is ______ (hot) than the Taklimakan Desert.
questions.e: hot 双写 t 加 -er。
questions.s: The Sahara is hotter than the Taklimakan Desert.

questions.a: Mount Qomolangma is the highest mountain in the world.
questions.e: the + 最高级 + 名词 + in the world。
questions.s: Mount Qomolangma is the highest mountain in the world.

points.title: 大数字与 How + 形容词
points.explain:
大数字从右往左每三位一个逗号：thousand（千）、million（百万）、billion（十亿）
8,849 → eight thousand, eight hundred and forty-nine
具体数字前 hundred / thousand / million 不加 -s：two million people；表示「成千上万」时加 -s 和 of：thousands of tourists
问高度、长度、深度：How high / long / deep / big is …?

examples.en: Mount Qomolangma is one of the greatest wonders of the world, and it is still growing taller.
examples.zh: 珠穆朗玛峰是世界上最伟大的奇观之一，而且它还在长高。

examples.en: That is bigger than the country of Belgium!
examples.zh: 那比比利时这个国家还要大！

questions.q: There are about five ______ people in the city.
questions.e: 具体数字 + million，不加 -s 和 of。
questions.s: There are about five million people in the city.

questions.q: ______ tourists visit the Great Wall every year.
questions.e: 表示「成千上万的」：thousands of。
questions.s: Thousands of tourists visit the Great Wall every year.

questions.q:
— ______ is the Yangtze River?
— It's about 6,300 kilometres long.
questions.e: 问长度用 How long。
questions.s:
— How long is the Yangtze River?
— It's about 6,300 kilometres long.

questions.q:
— ______ is Lake Baikal?
— It's about 1,642 metres deep.
questions.e: 问深度用 How deep。
questions.s:
— How deep is Lake Baikal?
— It's about 1,642 metres deep.

questions.q: The mountain is 8,849 metres ______ (高).
questions.e: 数字 + metres high 有……高。
questions.s: The mountain is 8,849 metres high.

questions.q: Two ______ (hundred) students took part in the race.
questions.e: 具体数字后 hundred 不加 -s。
questions.s: Two hundred students took part in the race.

points.title: 介绍自然奇观
points.explain:
描述位置：It is located in … / It lies in the north of …
描述特点：It is … metres high / long / deep. / It is famous for …
发出号召：Come and visit … / We should protect it at all costs.

examples.en: Located on the northeastern coast of Australia, the Great Barrier Reef is one of the most amazing places to visit.
examples.zh: 大堡礁位于澳大利亚东北海岸，是最令人惊叹的旅游胜地之一。

examples.en: We should protect them at all costs.
examples.zh: 我们应该不惜一切代价保护它们。

questions.q: Qinghai Lake is ______ in the northeast of the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau.
questions.e: be located in 位于。
questions.s: Qinghai Lake is located in the northeast of the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau.

questions.q: Huangshan is famous ______ its beautiful pine trees.
questions.e: be famous for 因……而著名。
questions.s: Huangshan is famous for its beautiful pine trees.

questions.q: We should protect nature ______ all costs.
questions.e: at all costs 不惜一切代价。
questions.s: We should protect nature at all costs.

questions.q: The lake still ______ (吸引) many curious travellers.
questions.e: 主语三单，attract 加 -s。
questions.s: The lake still attracts many curious travellers.

questions.a: Guilin is famous for its scenery.
questions.e: be famous for 因……而著名。
questions.s: Guilin is famous for its scenery.

points.title: 过去进行时：when / while
points.explain:
表示过去某一时刻或某段时间正在进行的动作：was / were + 动词-ing。
常和 at 8 p.m. yesterday, at that time, this time yesterday 连用：What were you doing at 8 o'clock last night?
when：后面常接短暂动作（一般过去时），主句用过去进行时：I was reading when the earthquake happened.
while：后面常接持续动作（过去进行时）：While I was waiting for the bus, it started to rain.

examples.en: When the typhoon hit, my family were having dinner at home.
examples.zh: 台风来袭时，我家正在吃晚饭。

examples.en: I was doing my homework when the building shook all of a sudden.
examples.zh: 我正在写作业，突然楼晃了起来。

questions.q:
— What ______ you doing at 9 o'clock last night?
— I was reading a book.
questions.e: 答语是过去进行时，问句用 were you doing。
questions.s:
— What were you doing at 9 o'clock last night?
— I was reading a book.

questions.q: I ______ a shower when the phone rang.
questions.e: 电话响时我「正在」洗澡，用过去进行时。
questions.s: I was taking a shower when the phone rang.

questions.q: ______ my mum was cooking, I was cleaning the room.
questions.e: 两个动作同时持续进行，用 while。
questions.s: While my mum was cooking, I was cleaning the room.

questions.q: They were playing football ______ it began to rain.
questions.e: began to rain 是短暂动作，用 when。
questions.s: They were playing football when it began to rain.

questions.q:
— Did you see the earthquake news?
— Yes. I ______ TV at that time.
questions.e: at that time「那时正在」，用过去进行时。
questions.s:
— Did you see the earthquake news?
— Yes. I was watching TV at that time.

questions.q: This time yesterday, we ______ (climb) the mountain.
questions.e: this time yesterday 昨天这个时候，主语 we 用 were climbing。
questions.s: This time yesterday, we were climbing the mountain.

questions.a: She was sleeping when I arrived.
questions.e: 主句过去进行时 + when + 一般过去时。
questions.s: She was sleeping when I arrived.

points.title: 谈自然灾害经历
points.explain:
问经历：What were you doing when the typhoon hit? / Did your family have any trouble?
描述：The wind was blowing hard. / The rain was beating against the window.
准备：We should prepare food, water, and a torch. / Stay away from windows.

examples.en: Did your family have any trouble during the typhoon?
examples.zh: 台风期间你家遇到什么麻烦了吗？

examples.en: We were so thankful that they found us!
examples.zh: 他们找到了我们，我们真是太感激了！

questions.q:
— What were you doing ______ the rainstorm came?
— I was walking home.
questions.e: the rainstorm came 是短暂动作，用 when。
questions.s:
— What were you doing when the rainstorm came?
— I was walking home.

questions.q: All ______ a sudden, thunder rolled across the sky.
questions.e: all of a sudden 突然。
questions.s: All of a sudden, thunder rolled across the sky.

questions.q: By the time the bus came, I ______ cold and wet.
questions.e: 讲过去的事，主语 I 用 was。
questions.s: By the time the bus came, I was cold and wet.

questions.q: When we finally got home, we were out of ______ (呼吸).
questions.e: out of breath 上气不接下气。
questions.s: When we finally got home, we were out of breath.

questions.e: 一般疑问句里用 any。
questions.s: Did you have any trouble?

points.title: so … that / unless / as soon as
points.explain:
so + 形容词 / 副词 + that：如此……以至于：The tea was so hot that I couldn't drink it.
unless 除非、如果不（= if … not）：You'll be late unless you hurry.
as soon as 一……就……：In Japan, we bow as soon as we meet a teacher.
unless 和 as soon as 引导的从句里，用一般现在时表示将来（主将从现）。

examples.en: But English table manners are so confusing that I'm a little worried.
examples.zh: 但英国的餐桌礼仪太令人困惑了，我有点担心。

examples.en: In Japan, we bow as soon as we meet a teacher.
examples.zh: 在日本，我们一见到老师就鞠躬。

questions.q: The box is ______ heavy ______ I can't carry it.
questions.e: so + 形容词 + that 如此……以至于。
questions.s: The box is so heavy that I can't carry it.

questions.q: You won't pass the exam ______ you work harder.
questions.e: 「除非你更努力，否则考不过」，用 unless。
questions.s: You won't pass the exam unless you work harder.

questions.q: I'll call you as soon as I ______ in Paris.
questions.e: as soon as 引导的从句用一般现在时表将来。
questions.s: I'll call you as soon as I arrive in Paris.

questions.q: Don't take photos ______ people say it's OK.
questions.e: 「除非别人同意，否则别拍照」。
questions.s: Don't take photos unless people say it's OK.

questions.q: She spoke so fast ______ nobody understood her.
questions.e: so … that 结构。
questions.s: She spoke so fast that nobody understood her.

questions.q: I'll tell her the news as ______ as she comes back.
questions.e: as soon as 一……就……
questions.s: I'll tell her the news as soon as she comes back.

questions.a: It was so cold that we stayed in.
questions.e: so + 形容词 + that + 句子。
questions.s: It was so cold that we stayed in.

points.title: 谈习俗与礼仪
points.explain:
问习俗：What should I do when …? / Is it polite to …? / What are the table manners in …?
说规矩：You're supposed to … / It's rude to … / You shouldn't …
回应：Thanks for the advice. / That's so different from …

examples.en: Could you give me some advice on table manners?
examples.zh: 你能给我一些关于餐桌礼仪的建议吗？

examples.en: It's also rude to talk while your mouth is full.
examples.zh: 嘴里塞满东西说话也是不礼貌的。

questions.q: In China, it's ______ to stick your chopsticks into your rice.
questions.e: 把筷子插在饭里是不礼貌的。
questions.s: In China, it's rude to stick your chopsticks into your rice.

questions.q: In the US, people usually shake ______ when they meet.
questions.e: shake hands 握手。
questions.s: In the US, people usually shake hands when they meet.

questions.q: Keep your elbows ______ the table.
questions.e: keep … off 使避开。
questions.s: Keep your elbows off the table.

questions.q: In many places, it's important to dress for the ______ (场合).
questions.e: dress for the occasion 根据场合穿着。
questions.s: In many places, it's important to dress for the occasion.

questions.e: It's + 形容词 + to do。
questions.s: It's rude to talk loudly.

points.title: 现在完成时（一）：already / yet / ever / never / just
points.explain:
have / has + 过去分词，表示过去发生的动作对现在有影响，或到现在为止的经历。
already 已经（肯定句）：I have already finished the book.
yet 还、已经（否定句和疑问句，放句末）：Have you read it yet? / I haven't read it yet.
ever 曾经（疑问句）、never 从未：Have you ever read Treasure Island? — No, I've never read it.
just 刚刚：He has just come back.

examples.en: I've just finished Alice's Adventures in Wonderland by Lewis Carroll.
examples.zh: 我刚读完刘易斯·卡罗尔的《爱丽丝梦游仙境》。

examples.en: Have you decided on a book for your report?
examples.zh: 你决定好读书报告写哪本书了吗？

questions.q:
— Have you ever ______ The Little Prince?
— Yes, I have.
questions.e: 现在完成时 have + 过去分词，read 的过去分词还是 read。
questions.s:
— Have you ever read The Little Prince?
— Yes, I have.

questions.q: I haven't finished my homework ______.
questions.e: 否定句末用 yet。
questions.s: I haven't finished my homework yet.

questions.q: She ______ been to Beijing. She wants to go there one day.
questions.e: 「想有一天去」，说明从没去过：has never been。
questions.s: She has never been to Beijing. She wants to go there one day.

questions.q:
— Have you cleaned your room yet?
— Yes, I've ______ cleaned it.
questions.e: 肯定句用 already。
questions.s:
— Have you cleaned your room yet?
— Yes, I've already cleaned it.

questions.q: Tom ______ the book three times.
questions.e: 到现在为止读过三遍，用现在完成时，主语三单 has。
questions.s: Tom has read the book three times.

questions.q: He has just ______ (come) back from the library.
questions.e: come 的过去分词是 come。
questions.s: He has just come back from the library.

questions.q: Have you ______ (see) the film Ne Zha?
questions.e: see 的过去分词是 seen。
questions.s: Have you seen the film Ne Zha?

questions.a: Have you ever read Oliver Twist?
questions.e: Have you ever + 过去分词？
questions.s: Have you ever read Oliver Twist?

points.title: 谈论读过的书
points.explain:
问书：What have you read recently? / What's it about? / Who wrote it?
说内容：It's a fantasy / mystery / adventure story about … / The main character is …
说感受：It taught me not to give up. / I highly recommend it.

examples.en: What have you read recently?
examples.zh: 你最近读了什么书？

examples.en: This book has taught me not to give up or doubt myself.
examples.zh: 这本书教会了我不要放弃，也不要怀疑自己。

questions.q:
— What's the book ______?
— It's about a boy and his adventures.
questions.e: What's it about? 问内容。
questions.s:
— What's the book about?
— It's about a boy and his adventures.

questions.q:
— Who ______ Journey to the West?
— Wu Cheng'en.
questions.e: 问过去写的书，用一般过去时 wrote。
questions.s:
— Who wrote Journey to the West?
— Wu Cheng'en.

questions.q: Sherlock Holmes is a famous ______.
questions.e: 福尔摩斯是著名侦探。
questions.s: Sherlock Holmes is a famous detective.

questions.q: I highly ______ (推荐) this book to you.
questions.e: recommend 推荐。
questions.s: I highly recommend this book to you.

questions.a: The main character is a fisherman.
questions.e: the main character 主人公。
questions.s: The main character is a fisherman.

points.title: 现在完成时（二）：since / for
points.explain:
表示从过去开始、一直持续到现在的动作或状态。
for + 一段时间：for three years, for a long time
since + 过去的时间点 / 从句：since 2020, since last August, since I was ten
问「多久了」用 How long：How long have you been a volunteer? — For two years.
短暂动词（buy, join, die…）不能和一段时间连用，要换成延续性的：join → be in / be a member of，buy → have，die → be dead

examples.en: I have been a volunteer here for a few months.
examples.zh: 我在这里做志愿者已经几个月了。

examples.en: She has been a volunteer at a nursing home since last August.
examples.zh: 从去年八月起，她一直在一家养老院做志愿者。

questions.q: I have lived in Zhengzhou ______ 2018.
questions.e: 2018 是时间点，用 since。
questions.s: I have lived in Zhengzhou since 2018.

questions.q: He has been a volunteer ______ two years.
questions.e: two years 是一段时间，用 for。
questions.s: He has been a volunteer for two years.

questions.q:
— ______ have you had this bike?
— For three years.
questions.e: 问持续多久用 How long。
questions.s:
— How long have you had this bike?
— For three years.

questions.q: My grandpa ______ the club since he retired.
questions.e: join 是短暂动词，不能和 since 连用，改为 has been in。
questions.s: My grandpa has been in the club since he retired.

questions.q: She ______ English since she was six.
questions.e: since + 过去时间，主句用现在完成时。
questions.s: She has learned English since she was six.

questions.q: They have known each other ______ ten years.
questions.e: ten years 是一段时间，用 for。
questions.s: They have known each other for ten years.

questions.q: I have ______ (be) a member of the club since last term.
questions.e: be 的过去分词是 been。
questions.s: I have been a member of the club since last term.

questions.e: How long + have + 主语 + 过去分词？
questions.s: How long have you volunteered?

points.title: 谈志愿服务
points.explain:
问经历：How long have you been a volunteer? / What do you do there? / What inspired you to volunteer?
说做法：I help out at … / I read to the elderly / I clean the cages.
说收获：It has taught me … / It makes me feel useful. / It's worth it.

examples.en: Most of all, being a volunteer has taught me the value of every life.
examples.zh: 最重要的是，做志愿者让我懂得了每个生命的价值。

examples.en: And that makes everything we do worth it.
examples.zh: 这让我们做的一切都值得。

questions.q: What ______ you to volunteer at the animal shelter?
questions.e: 过去激励了你，用 inspired。
questions.s: What inspired you to volunteer at the animal shelter?

questions.q: I often help ______ at the nursing home on weekends.
questions.e: help out 帮忙。
questions.s: I often help out at the nursing home on weekends.

questions.q: We should help people ______ need.
questions.e: people in need 需要帮助的人。
questions.s: We should help people in need.

questions.q: Hard work is ______ (值得) it.
questions.e: be worth it 值得。
questions.s: Hard work is worth it.

questions.a: Volunteering has taught me a lot.
questions.e: 现在完成时：has taught。
questions.s: Volunteering has taught me a lot.
